dependencyDecision: A5.5 and A4.12 do not need new source subjects because squad identity, remaining MF and below-limit stacking are declared inputs; hidden occupancy, fortification, road, Bypass, elevation, SSR and other modifiers are explicitly excluded. Unknown inputs are outside this decision.
caseDecision: For the declared Good Order Infantry squad during its MPh, entry into an adjacent empty ground-level ordinary wooden or stone building is permitted at 2 MF, provided the declared movement capability, available MF, stacking and absence of special modifiers are true.
